# Testing Output Directory

This directory contains load test results generated by the vegeta load testing scripts.

## Generated Files

Each test run creates timestamped files:

- `vegeta-results-YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.bin` - Binary results file (for vegeta tooling)
- `report-YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.json` - Detailed JSON metrics report
- `plot-YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.html` - Interactive HTML latency plot

## Usage

After running a load test:

```bash
# Run test (outputs are automatically saved here)
./ops/local/run-load-test

# View the latest HTML plot
open ops/local/testing_output/plot-*.html

# Analyze JSON report
cat ops/local/testing_output/report-*.json | jq .

# Regenerate plot from binary results
vegeta plot ops/local/testing_output/vegeta-results-*.bin > custom-plot.html

# Generate text report from binary results
vegeta report -type=text < ops/local/testing_output/vegeta-results-*.bin
```

## Cleanup

All files in this directory are ignored by git. To clean up old test results:

```bash
# Remove all test outputs
rm ops/local/testing_output/*.{bin,json,html}

# Or remove files older than 7 days
find ops/local/testing_output -name "*.bin" -mtime +7 -delete
find ops/local/testing_output -name "*.json" -mtime +7 -delete
find ops/local/testing_output -name "*.html" -mtime +7 -delete
```
